versionChangeAfterRuntime: Version metadata only. The final artifact was rebuilt after gameplay acceptance.

runtime.restoration: The temporary install returned to the 24.3.0 digest. DP-3 configuration, test profile and profile-selection hashes matched the baseline. The owned process exited via normal shutdown and the Steam exit code was unavailable.

limits: The live scenarios used a Day board. The first sampled Cherry Drone offset already followed the first impact. Continuous pre-impact movement, exact impact ticks and a save/load roundtrip were outside this run.
